'''Giles''' was an [[Gender|male]] [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial cadet|cadet]]<ref name="Rebel in the Ranks" /> [[Reproduction|born]] by [[18 BBY]]<ref name="Giles age" /> at the [[Academy for Young Imperials]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]<ref name="Rebel in the Ranks" /> in [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Academy year">Giles was a [[Imperial cadet|cadet]] at the [[Academy for Young Imperials]] alongside [[Zare Leonis]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' established that Leonis was a cadet in [[5 BBY]], meaning that Giles was also a cadet at that time.</ref> When the Empire questioned cadets at Lothal's [[Imperial Academy|Imperial Academies]] to flush out traitors, Giles was among the cadets who heard a rumor that dozens of cadets from a regional academy were expelled. Giles also learned from their [[Giles's brother|brother]] that a cadet from the [[Pretor Flats]] [[Pretor Flats Academy|Academy]] supposedly admitted to treason and was taken into custody by [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="Imperial Justice">''[[Servants of the Empire: Imperial Justice]]''</ref>

Later, Giles was paired with [[Uzall]] for a training mission where pairs of cadets went door-to-door to question [[Capital City]] residents about any illegal activities they had observed. At the end of the exercise, when each team of cadets was awards points according to the results of their interrogation, Uzall and Giles finished in first place thanks to a weapons [[smuggler]] who fled from one of the houses in the area they were assigned.<ref name="Imperial Justice" />

Giles, along with the other members of [[Unit Besh]], was considered potential [[Imperial officer|officer]] material.<ref name="Rebel in the Ranks" />
